reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verified: handle_blobs_by_root_request_inner (L289-366) processes BlobsByRoot requests without any epoch-based deprecation check. No validation compares current_epoch against FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. Spec SG-013 requires full deprecation (respond empty/reject) after this threshold. However, this is a protocol compliance gap, not a security vulnerability. Impact is limited to resource waste on deprecated endpoints and protocol non-compliance. Does not cause validator slashing, network splits, ETH loss, or node crashes. According to BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE severity definitions, this falls below Low severity threshold (requires >0.01% network crash/split). Severity downgraded from Medium to Informational as it's a spec compliance observation without exploitable security impact.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-013 blob_sidecars_by_root_deprecated: INV-001 requires full deprecation after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS with respond empty/reject behavior.
